title: Administration
subtitle: Councils on the platform and the people who manage them.

guard.signIn: Sign in to open the administration.
guard.forbiddenBody: This area is only for the platform’s superadministrators.

councils.empty: No councils yet. Create the first one.

form.createDescription: Its page goes live at once; its administrator adds the facilities.
form.name: Name
form.adminEmailHelp: They get the administrator role when they sign in with this email verified.
form.activeHelp: A deactivated council disappears from the web and takes no bookings; its data is kept.
form.municipalityCodeHelp: Five digits (e.g. 36024 for Lalín): MeteoGalicia’s forecast at outdoor facilities.

manage.detailsHelp: The name, logo and contact details residents see on the council's page.
manage.adminsHelp: Who can manage the facilities, the bookings and these settings.
manage.noAdmins: Nobody has accepted an invitation yet.
manage.deleteHelp: Only for a council created by mistake: it removes its facilities and timetables for good.
manage.deleteBlocked_one: It has {{count}} booking: deactivate it instead, so its history is kept.
manage.deleteBlocked_other: It has {{count}} bookings: deactivate it instead, so its history is kept.
manage.deleteConfirmBody: The council, its facilities, timetables and invitations are deleted. This cannot be undone.

notice.created: Council created: {{name}}. {{email}} becomes its administrator on signing in.

superadmins.help: They create and manage every council. Add someone who has already signed in once.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.guardBody: This area is for the council’s administrators.
facilities.empty: No facilities yet. Create the first one.

editor.name: Name
editor.tagsHelp: Every sport that can be played and what the facility is like. Residents filter by them.
editor.contactNone: Empty: the council has none either, so none is shown.
editor.noResults: No place found: place the pin by clicking on the map.
editor.mapHelp: Click on the map or drag the pin to the exact entrance.
editor.usageRulesHelp: Residents must read and accept them before every booking.
editor.activeHelp: An inactive facility is hidden and takes no bookings.
editor.scheduleHelp: Slots are cut from these windows; a window can be split (for example morning and afternoon).
editor.scheduleWithCreate: Slots are cut within these windows; a day can have several (morning and afternoon, for example). It is saved with the facility when you create it.
editor.deleteHelp: Only for a facility created by mistake. With bookings, deactivate it instead.
editor.deleteConfirmBody: Its opening hours are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
editor.minAgeHelp: Leave it empty if there is no age control (1 to 80).
editor.activeInfoActive: Active: it appears on the council’s page, has its own page and takes bookings.
editor.activeInfoInactive: Inactive: it disappears from the website and takes no new bookings. Bookings already made are kept, unless you choose to cancel them when deactivating. It can be activated again at any time.
editor.activeInfoWhen: Use it for a facility that is no longer offered. For works, maintenance or an event, add a closure below instead: only the bookings inside its dates are cancelled.

activeConfirm.activateBody: It will appear on the council’s website again and take bookings.
activeConfirm.deactivateBody: It will disappear from the website and stop taking new bookings. You can activate it again at any time.
activeConfirm.keepNote_one: It has {{count}} upcoming booking. It is kept: whoever booked can still come.
activeConfirm.keepNote_other: It has {{count}} upcoming bookings. They are kept: whoever booked can still come.
activeConfirm.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. The facility closes for good
activeConfirm.reasonHint: It goes in the notice and the apology email each owner receives.
activeConfirm.noBookings: It has no upcoming bookings: nobody is affected.
activeConfirm.activated: Facility activated: it takes bookings again.
activeConfirm.deactivatedKept_one: Facility deactivated. Its upcoming booking is kept.
activeConfirm.deactivatedKept_other: Facility deactivated. Its {{count}} upcoming bookings are kept.
activeConfirm.deactivatedCancelled_one: Facility deactivated. {{count}} booking was cancelled and its owner notified.
activeConfirm.deactivatedCancelled_other: Facility deactivated. {{count}} bookings were cancelled and their owners notified.

editor.tagsEmpty: There are no tags yet: ask a superadministrator.
editor.showWeatherHelp: Show MeteoGalicia forecasts on the facility page and when booking. Requires the council’s INE code. Independent of tags.

readers.title: Entrance QR readers
readers.help: A reader is a device at the entrance (a tablet or an IoT reader) that scans the booking QR and records the entry. It only accepts bookings for this facility, from 15 minutes before the start until the end.
readers.empty: No readers yet. Add one for each entrance that checks bookings.
readers.name: Reader name
readers.createdBody: Open the link on the device at the entrance: it signs in with its key and asks for the camera.
readers.keyHelp: For a device of your own: send it as Authorization: Bearer <key> to POST /api/reader/checkin.
readers.onlyOnce: Copy it now: the key is not shown again. If it gets lost, remove the reader and add another one.
readers.removeBody: Its key stops working at once. The entries it already recorded are kept.

closures.title: Closures
closures.help: Close the facility for a while: works, maintenance, an event. Those hours show as closed, and the bookings inside are cancelled; each owner gets a notice and an apology email with the reason.
closures.reasonHint: Residents see it on the facility page and in the apology notice.
closures.deleteHint: Reopens those hours. Bookings already cancelled stay cancelled.
closures.deleted: Closure removed: those hours can be booked again.
closures.confirmTitle: Cancel the bookings in that closure?
closures.confirmBody_one: {{count}} booking falls inside those dates. It will be cancelled and its owner gets a notice and an apology email.
closures.confirmBody_other: {{count}} bookings fall inside those dates. They will be cancelled and each owner gets a notice and an apology email.
closures.saved_one: Closure saved. {{count}} booking was cancelled and its owner notified.
closures.saved_other: Closure saved. {{count}} bookings were cancelled and their owners notified.
closures.savedNone: Closure saved. No bookings were affected.

invitation.bannerTitle: You’ve been made an administrator of {{council}}.
invitation.bannerBody: To accept, verify your email address ({{email}}): sign in again and enter the code we email you.
invitation.pageBody: The role is waiting for you: it is only given to a verified email address, so nobody can claim someone else’s. Sign in again and enter the code we email to {{email}}; you will come back here as an administrator.

councilAdmin.title: Council management
councilAdmin.subtitle: Facilities, opening hours, rules, bookings and indicators.

indicators.title: Indicators

kpi.activeUsersHint: With at least one booking, their own or through an invite
kpi.noShowsHint: {{missed}} of {{finished}} past bookings that could be checked in
kpi.noShowsNone: No past bookings that could be checked in

indicators.showTable: Show the data as a table
indicators.busyHint: Confirmed bookings by day and starting hour. The stronger the colour, the more bookings.
indicators.empty: No bookings in this period yet.
indicators.definitions: Occupancy divides the booked hours by the hours that could be booked, leaving out closures. No-shows only count for slots that began while the facility took check-ins (QR reader switched on, code, QR at the door or staff). The figures are worked out live from the bookings.
indicators.exportNote: Totals only, never bookings or people. Counts of 1 or 2 show as “<3”.

daily.label: By facility and day
daily.hint: Bookings, hours and occupancy of each day

hours.label: Days and hours
hours.hint: Bookings by weekday and starting hour

usage.label: How often people book
usage.hint: How many people booked 1, 2–4, 5–9 or 10+ times

habits.partyHint: Whoever books plus the people who join
habits.leadHint: Half of the bookings are made further ahead than this

indicators.weekdaysHint: Hours booked out of the hours open on each weekday.
indicators.byFacilityHint: Select a facility to see its detail.
indicators.customInvalid: Choose a start date before the end date, at most a year apart.

smtp.title: Email server (SMTP)
smtp.help: {{app}} sends booking confirmations, reminders, cancellations and administrator invitations for this council. Set up the council’s own server to send them from its address; otherwise they go through the platform’s server.
smtp.noneWarning: There is no server to send through: emails for this council are waiting and will go out once you set one up.
smtp.fromHelp: The address residents see. The server must allow sending from it.
smtp.passwordKept: Saved: leave empty to keep it
smtp.tlsHelp: The connection is encrypted with STARTTLS (usually port 587). Implicit TLS on port 465 is not supported.
smtp.saved: Saved. The council’s emails now go through this server.
smtp.testSentCouncil: Test email sent to {{email}} through the council’s server.
smtp.testSentPlatform: Test email sent to {{email}} through the platform’s server.
smtp.removeBodyPlatform: The saved settings are deleted and the council’s emails go through the platform’s server.
smtp.removeBodyNone: The saved settings are deleted. The platform has no server, so the council’s emails will wait until one is set up.
smtp.unreadable: The saved settings can’t be read because the server’s encryption key changed. Type them again, password included, and save.

councilExport.title: Export the council’s data
councilExport.help: A ZIP with everything the council keeps in {{app}}, to take it to another system: facilities and usage rules, opening hours, closures, QR readers and every booking, as CSV, with the original images and a datapackage.json (Frictionless Data) describing each column.
councilExport.privacy: It holds no passwords or keys. Without the personal data, each resident appears only as their account id.
councilExport.personalHelp: Adds people.csv (name, email, phone, birth date and language of whoever booked or joined a booking) and the guests’ names and ages. The council is the controller of this data under the GDPR: keep it safe and use it only to move the service to another system.

staff.title: Bookings by phone or at the desk
staff.help: For residents who call or come in: book a free slot for them, with their account or just their name, and cancel any booking before it starts.
staff.noFacilities: There are no active facilities to book.
staff.minAge: Minimum age {{age}}: check it for people without an account.
staff.closedDay: The facility has no slots on this day.
staff.caption: Slots and bookings on {{date}}
staff.noName: No name (deleted account or removed after 30 days)
staff.emailHelp: They get the confirmation and the QR by email, and see the booking in the app.
staff.name: Name
staff.privacyHelp: To call them about a closure or a cancellation. The name and phone are removed 30 days after the booking.
staff.toldRules: I have told them the facility’s usage rules
staff.bookedAccount: Booked for {{name}}. They get the confirmation and the QR by email.
staff.qrHint: Print it or let them take a photo: the reader at the entrance lets them in with it.
staff.ticketHint: Show this QR to the reader at the entrance, from 15 minutes before the start.
staff.cancelNotice: They get a notice and an email saying the council cancelled it.
staff.cancelCall: They have no account and get no notice: call them on {{phone}} if they do not know yet.
staff.cancelNoContact: They have no account and left no phone, so nobody will be told.

checkedInMethod.reader: Checked in with the QR reader.
checkedInMethod.printed_qr: Checked in with the printed QR.
checkedInMethod.entry_code: Came in with the entry code.

staff.checkinTooEarly: The check-in can be marked from {{time}}.
staff.checkinEnded: The slot ended without a check-in.

tags.help: The tag catalogue for every council, in categories. Councils tag their facilities with them (a facility can have several), and residents filter by them on the home page and on each council’s page.
tags.deleteCategoryBody_one: Its {{count}} tag goes with it, and comes off {{facilities}} facilities.
tags.deleteCategoryBody_other: Its {{count}} tags go with it, and come off {{facilities}} facilities.
tags.slugHelp: Addresses keep using “{{slug}}”, even if you rename it.
tags.deleteTagBody_one: It also comes off the facility that has it. This cannot be undone.
tags.deleteTagBody_other: It also comes off the {{count}} facilities that have it. This cannot be undone.

checkin.title: How people check in
checkin.help: Choose one or several ways for residents to check in at the entrance. They all end in the same check-in on the booking, so attendance and the indicators stay the same. Pick by budget and by how much cheating matters here.
checkin.preview: The QR reader, the printed QR, the entry code and staff confirmation work. NFC is a preview: its choices are not saved.

reader.name: Booking or flash QR on a reader
reader.how: The resident shows the QR of their booking, or their personal flash QR, to a device with a camera at the door.
reader.door: a phone, tablet or small computer running the reader
reader.cheat: yes, the codes are per booking or change every minute
reader.off: The reader is off: it refuses every QR until you turn it back on. It stays set up below.

printedQr.name: Printed QR at the door
printedQr.how: The resident scans a sheet with the facility’s QR, and the app checks in their booking for this slot.
printedQr.cheat: low on its own: the phone’s location is always checked
printedQr.qrAlt: QR to check in at the facility
printedQr.newBody: The QRs already printed stop working at once. Print the new one and change the sheets on the doors.
printedQr.rotated: New QR ready. Print it and change the old sheets.

nfc.name: NFC tag
nfc.how: The resident taps a sticker on the door with their phone, which opens the check-in page.
nfc.cheat: low with a plain tag, high with a signed one
nfc.signedHelp: Each tap carries a signature and a counter that the server checks, so a copied or recorded tap does not work.
nfc.plainHelp: A plain tag only holds the address and can be copied: add the location check.

entryCode.name: Entry code
entryCode.how: The door or the desk shows the facility’s fixed code; the resident types it on their phone.
entryCode.cheat: low on its own: the phone’s location is always checked
entryCode.help: A six-digit code that stays the same until you make a new one. The phone’s location is always checked.
entryCode.newBody: The code already printed stops working at once. Print the new one and change the sheets.
entryCode.rotated: New code ready. Print it and change the old sheets.

staff.name: Staff confirmation
staff.how: Staff mark the check-in from the booking on the manual booking calendar.
staff.help: Open a booking in the manual booking tab and press “Mark as checked in”, from 15 minutes before the start until the slot ends. If you picked the wrong booking, you can undo it for 5 minutes.
staff.contactsHelp: Who residents can ask at the facility to check in or book a free slot. They need no account: only what you write here is shown.
staff.placePlaceholder: For example: reception, at the entrance
staff.fallback: With none, the facility’s contact is shown, or the council’s if it has none.

location.help: The printed QR and the entry code only work with the phone this close to the facility’s map pin. The resident has to allow their location, which is checked and never stored.
location.radius: Distance from the pin, in metres
location.noPin: Put the facility on the map in the Details tab to use the printed QR or the entry code: the phone’s location is checked against its pin.
location.required: Residents checking in with the printed QR or the entry code must be within {{metres}} m of the facility.

checkin.loadError: The check-in settings could not be loaded.
checkin.saveToPrint: Turn it on and save to print it.

flash.label: Allow flash booking
flash.help: Without a booking, a resident can book the slot under way or about to start on the spot, under the usual rules: with the personal QR at a reader, the entry code or the QR at the door. Those who already have a booking get in either way.

print.qrStep1: Scan this QR with your phone’s camera.
print.qrStep2: Sign in if you are asked to, and allow your location.
print.qrStep3: Your booking for this slot is checked in.
print.qrStep3Flash: Your booking for this slot is checked in. Without a booking, you can book a free slot on the spot.
print.codeStep1: Open {{url}} on your phone and type this code.
print.brailleHelp: The braille comes out to scale. To be read by touch, print it on swell (microcapsule) paper or on a braille embosser: on a plain printer the dots come out flat.

branding.title: App name and logo
branding.help: To offer the service under your own brand: the name and logo appear in the top bar, the tab titles, the browser icon, the QR reader screens and the emails. The footer still says it runs on LibreQuenda, free software.
branding.name: App name
branding.logoHelp: Square works best, with a transparent background (PNG or WebP). No logo: {{app}}’s.

rules.maxAdvanceHelp: How long before a slot it can be booked, counted from now.
rules.minAdvanceHelp: The app books no slot starting sooner. Flash booking at the door and staff do not count it.
rules.minCancelHelp: After that the booking can no longer be cancelled or changed.
rules.maxActiveHelp: How many they can hold at once.
rules.inARow: Slots in a row per person
rules.penaltyHelp: After several bookings without a check-in, the person cannot book for some days. Only counts where check-ins are taken.
rules.sumMinAdvance_one: From the app, at least {{count}} minute before.
rules.sumMinAdvance_other: From the app, at least {{count}} minutes before.
rules.sumCancel_one: Cancel or change until {{count}} hour before.
rules.sumCancel_other: Cancel or change until {{count}} hours before.
rules.sumInARow_other: Up to {{count}} slots in a row.
rules.sumPenalty: Penalty: {{limit}} no-shows in {{window}} days block {{block}} days.
rules.councilHelp: The one every facility of the council uses, except those with their own. Saving it changes it in them at once. Staff booking for someone skip the per-person limits.
rules.saved: Window saved and applied to the facilities that inherit it.
rules.useCouncilHelp: Turn it off to give this facility its own advance, limits and penalty.
rules.facilityHelp: How far ahead it can be booked, the limits per person and the no-show penalty at this facility.
rules.rolling: Rolling window: up to some time ahead
rules.weekly: Weekly opening at a fixed time
rules.rollingHelp: Each slot can be booked from the advance you set.
rules.weeklyHelp: Until the opening only this week can be booked; from then on, next week too. Fairer when demand is high.
rules.sumWeekly: Next week’s slots open on {{weekday}} at {{time}}.
rules.councilActive: Upcoming bookings per person across the council
rules.councilActiveHelp: Counting every facility of the council. 0 = no limit.
rules.sumCouncilActive_one: {{count}} upcoming booking per person across the council.
rules.sumCouncilActive_other: {{count}} upcoming bookings per person across the council.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.help: What administrators and the system did: who, when and what changed. It keeps no residents’ personal data nor anything they write. Entries are kept for the period the installation sets (two years by default).
audit.caption: Activity log, newest first

actions.facility.activation_changed: Switched a facility on or off
actions.branding.changed: Changed the app’s name or logo

widget.title: Widget for your website
widget.help: Show the facilities’ free slots on the council’s website: copy this code and paste it there. Each slot opens this app to book it.
widget.code: Code to paste on the website
widget.iframeTitle: Free slots at the sports facilities

issues.title: Maintenance list
issues.help: Problems residents reported at the facilities, newest first. When you mark one fixed or rejected, the person gets a notice and an email with your note.
issues.noteHelp: What was done, or why it will not be (required to reject).
issues.close: Close the facility or check its hours

bookingPolicy.title: Platform booking rules
bookingPolicy.oneCouncil: One council at a time per account
bookingPolicy.oneCouncilHelp: With upcoming bookings in one council (own or joined), a person cannot book or join in another until they are over. No council sees another's bookings.
